notes: Includes the legacy, vanity, and seasonal sets linked by the ST index.
The main file covers named four-slot sets listed by RealmEye; it does not invent sets from arbitrary gear combinations.
The gear-family companion preserves variable equipment choices under the source page section names. Some indexed gear families are themed reskins rather than actual bonus sets.
Source pages may lag the game; this is coverage of the retrieved wiki indexes, not a guarantee of every unlisted game asset.
Typographic apostrophes are normalized to ASCII.
Alternate-ring entry names are dataset labels, not distinct official set names.
